The problem size is too large for the allocated memory. # Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# This is done in a single RUN command to minimize image layers.
RUN mkdir -p /build \
    && cd /build \
    && git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git \
    && cd AMG2023 \
    && make \
    && cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && cd / \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, configure it, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# FIX: Added the './configure' step to generate required build files (e.g., HYPRE_config.h) before compilation.
RUN mkdir -p /build \
    && cd /build \
    && git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git \
    && cd AMG2023 \
    && ./configure \
    && make \
    && cp test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && cd / \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# FIX: Corrected the build process. AMG2023 requires running 'make' inside the 'test' directory
# and does not use a './configure' script.
RUN mkdir -p /build \
    && cd /build \
    && git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git \
    && cd AMG2023/test \
    && make \
    && cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && cd / \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# FIX: The git repository for 'AMG2023.git' clones into a directory named 'AMG'. Corrected the path.
RUN mkdir -p /build \
    && cd /build \
    && git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git \
    && cd AMG/test \
    && make \
    && cp amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && cd / \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# FIX: Using explicit paths and 'make -C' for a more robust build. This avoids
# potential issues with chained 'cd' commands within a single RUN layer.
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git /build \
    && make -C /build/test \
    && cp /build/test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# FIX: Corrected paths. 'git clone <repo> /build' creates a subdirectory
# for the repo contents, so the full path to source/binaries is /build/AMG2023/...
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git /build \
    && make -C /build/AMG2023/src \
    && cp /build/AMG2023/test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# FIX: The build must be invoked from the repository root, and the 'amg'
# executable is built by explicitly calling the 'test' target.
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git /build \
    && make -C /build \
    && make -C /build test \
    && cp /build/test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# - libhypre-dev: Provides the HYPRE library, a required dependency for AMG2023.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# FIX: Install libhypre-dev dependency and override hard-coded Makefile paths
# by providing the correct HYPRE include and library directories during the build.
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git /build \
    && make -C /build test \
         HYPRE_INC_DIR=/usr/include/hypre \
         HYPRE_LIB_DIR=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu \
    && cp /build/test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && rm -rf /build

FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# - libhypre-dev: Provides the HYPRE library, a required dependency for AMG2023.

    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# contains the correct Makefile for the 'amg' executable.

    && make -C /build/test \
         HYPRE_INC_DIR=/usr/include/hypre \
         HYPRE_LIB_DIR=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu \
    && cp /build/test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# - libhypre-dev: Provides the HYPRE library, a required dependency for AMG2023.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# - The 'amg' executable is built from the Makefile in the 'test' directory.
# - Hard-coded paths in the Makefile are overridden by providing the HYPRE
#   include and library directories for the installed libhypre-dev package.
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git /build \
    && make -C /build/test \
         HYPRE_INC_DIR=/usr/include/hypre \
         HYPRE_LIB_DIR=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu \
    && cp /build/test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && rm -rf /build

# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, common environment.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Avoid prompts during package installation.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, git, certificates, and MPI.
# - build-essential: Provides compilers (gcc, g++) and make.
# - ca-certificates: For secure network communications (e.g., git clone).
# - git: To clone the application source code.
# - openmpi-bin & libopenmpi-dev: For compiling and running MPI applications.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a specific requirement.
# - libhypre-dev: Provides the HYPRE library, a required dependency for AMG2023.
# We clean up apt cache in the same layer to reduce image size.
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    libgomp1 \
    libhypre-dev \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# This ensures MPI communication works over the network (TCP)
# instead of relying on SSH or shared memory mechanisms that may not be available.
ENV OMPI_MCA_plm_rsh_agent=false
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self

# Clone the latest branch of the amg2023 repository, compile it,
# copy the executable to a location on the system PATH, and clean up the source code.
# - The 'amg' executable is built from the Makefile in the 'test' directory.
# - Hard-coded paths in the Makefile are overridden by providing the HYPRE
#   include and library directories for the installed libhypre-dev package.
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG2023.git /build \
    && make -C /build/test \
         HYPRE_INC_DIR=/usr/include/hypre \
         HYPRE_LIB_DIR=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu \
    && cp /build/test/amg /usr/local/bin/amg \
    && rm -rf /build
